scope: Private host resource/request IDs must stay within the positive signed i32 Wasm import range. Released IDs are reusable; occupied IDs and reserved standard streams remain intact. No Lean API was added.
stressPolicy: The boundary is exercised by a three-slot table near INT32_MAX, not by allocating billions of resources.

names: host IDs reach the signed Wasm boundary and wrap without losing live resources
reserved standard handles survive repeated resource and request ID reuse
IO.sleep preserves durations beyond one Node timeout instead of clamping to 1ms
runtime teardown cancels sleeps and releases their Node timers
completion readiness preserves the result for its consuming Lean thread
Std.Async timers preserve UInt64 delays and reset without overflowing Node timeouts
a synchronous exit during request startup leaves no pending result

integration: The helper is included by application output copying, cache required-file validation, full-runtime freezing, and host-derivative creation. The ongoing frozen v35 full campaign predates this counter change and must not be counted as testing it.
